text: ATC cleared Alaska 421 to climb and maintain 11,000 ft and the pilot monitoring read back 11,000 ft. The pilot flying set 12,000 ft in the MCP and climbed, and the aircraft climbed from 8,980 ft through 10,760 ft to 11,820 ft. Crosscheck said "Cleared one-one thousand, set one-two thousand." at 40.7 s.
